prose.numerics_note: The final design was not rerun at finer settings; the 5 ps / 1e-5 default was chosen because it removed the 0.1 mV step artefacts that coarser settings produced with the bootstrapped switch.
prose.robustness_note: Levels on a 25 mV grid at the worst conditions give at most 0.13 `VLSB`.
prose.sens_sentence: Clock edges, phase skew, bias current, and `Cs` were held at their nominal values in this verification.
prose.numerics_method_sentence: for the first-cut transmission gate this setting agreed with finer ones within 0.003 mV, and for the bootstrapped switch it removed 0.1 mV artefacts of coarser settings.
prose.level_grids: 0.1 V pairs, 50 mV and 25 mV staircases
